# Tathmini Afya

> Tathmini Afya is a digital health platform to monitor health, evaluate risk factors, track vital signs, and receive timely guidance for preventing chronic disease.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Tathmini Afya and what it offers.
- [About](/about): The mission and team behind Tathmini Afya.
- [Features](/features): Health monitoring, assessments, and nutrition tools.
- [Shop](/shop): Recommended health products.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the Tathmini Afya support team.

## Optional

- [Try as guest](/try): Explore the patient dashboard without an account.
